question_pt: Qual o custo medio de internacao por sexo?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT s."DESCRICAO" AS sexo, ROUND(AVG(i."VAL_TOT"), 2) AS custo_medio FROM internacoes i JOIN sexo s ON i."SEXO" = s."SEXO" WHERE i."VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s."DESCRICAO" ORDER BY custo_medio DESC;
generated_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN i."SEXO" = 1 THEN 'Masculino' WHEN i."SEXO" = 3 THEN 'Feminino' END AS sexo, ROUND(AVG(i."VAL_TOT"), 2) AS custo_medio, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i GROUP BY i."SEXO";
